items.summary: Recommendation: reject the searchwoot.com sitemap candidate for now. The private-preview gate and noindex/nofollow state make crawl exposure premature and non-measurable. No repository, configuration, credential, infrastructure, schedule, telemetry, or production change should occur before owner approval and launch-readiness review.

Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and reject the sitemap candidate for now. The observed password gate and noindex/nofollow state are technically consistent with private preview; changing crawl exposure would conflict with release controls and lacks a measurable objective. No repository, configuration, credential, infrastructure, schedule, telemetry, or production change is authorized. Proceed only after owner choice and separate legal/compliance, security, data-rights, accuracy, privacy/consent, attribution, contribution-margin, and rollback review. Existing deployed improvements should remain isolated and continue their scheduled measurement gates without duplicate work.

Reject the sitemap candidate and all production work lacking a measurable outcome. The private-preview state makes crawl exposure premature. Keep the current posture until the owner selects keep-private, bounded beta, or full launch and Legal/Compliance, Security, data-rights, accuracy, privacy, disclosure, attribution, margin, and rollback gates are satisfied.

Reject the sitemap candidate and production work lacking a measurable outcome. No configuration, credential, infrastructure, schedule, telemetry, or production change is authorized while the private-preview posture remains.
